summary: Harness 2.21.0: Mode A aborts before scaffold when the typed symbol is not a real market ticker and has no obvious match. Typos/aliases abort with the printed match; do not auto-remap.
risks: Yahoo junk quotes (APPL as empty MUTUALFUND) are rejected; APPL suggests AAPL and APP.
CLI scaffold now needs network/yfinance; tests use the Python API (verify off) or FakeBackend.
Does not silently rewrite BRK.B → BRK-B; user must re-run with the match.
intended_commit_subject: Abort Mode A when the ticker is not a real market symbol
